svg.title: All three crooked clock faces agree while residents distrustfully check their watches.
svg.desc: The three clock mechanisms click into the same time above a pole that still leans east. Residents lift their own watches and phones in suspicion as Cecil verifies the signal.
svg.text: Page 26, panel 2 · Low medium shot on the crooked clock and residents checking watches

text.tspan: The three municipal clock faces agree for the first
time and the crowd immediately doubts them.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
